cases.source_review_rule: Require at least two of maintenance of the corpus luteum, promotion of decidualization, and placental formation in the answer and direct cited evidence from document 15928989. Report qrel retrieval on this derivative separately from original SciFact.

selection: QASPER ordered by salted SHA256(QID), distinct papers <=22000 characters; single annotator, one extractive span <=60 characters, one matching source paragraph <=1000 characters, or unanswerable. Add paper title to disambiguate in shared KB. First six positive and first negative. Full body with section headings, excluding figure/table captions. No test/dev split.
grading: Score the first HTTP response. HTTP errors, abstention on answerable fact, incorrect or unsupported material assertions fail. A correct cited answer must give the required result and its own returned excerpts must directly support every material assertion. Evaluate source identity and official evidence overlap separately. Absent controls require explicit abstention and no citations. SciFact qrels alone cannot establish the claim. Report historical and current baseline supported answer preservation separately. No outcome-driven replacements. Published evidence SHA-256 identifies the complete original answer annotation string; replay restores all six from the official TRAIN file.
